new_findings.root_cause: script drift: make_human_test.py assumed artifacts/datasets/ existed (true on author's machine); the R2-EX-N01 fix added the producing-commit disclosure but did not make the human_test path self-contained in a clean clone. Pin itself IS reproducible (5bd643a7) once the dir exists — documentation/robustness friction, not a provenance break.
